About Us

We are Homeroom Heroes, a 501(c) registered charity dedicated to supporting educators and enriching classrooms across the nation.

Our Mission

At Homeroom Heroes, our mission is to serve as a pivotal bridge between educators and community supporters, fostering meaningful connections that enhance educational experiences. With a steadfast commitment to the transformative power of education, we empower teachers by providing a platform to articulate their needs and aspirations, while enabling compassionate individuals to directly contribute to the enrichment of classrooms nationwide. Through our collaborative efforts, we strive to cultivate a brighter future for generations to come, one classroom at a time.

How Do We Do That?

At Homeroom Heroes, we simplify the process for teachers to showcase their needs by creating profiles and hosting curated wishlists of essential classroom supplies through Amazon. Our platform enables community members to make a direct impact by selecting and sending items straight to teachers’ classrooms—no middlemen, no extra fees. Every donation directly supports students by enhancing their learning environments. Together, we bridge the gap between community generosity and classroom success.

Website Terms and Conditions
Terms and Conditions
Meet the Team

We are a passionate team dedicated to making a positive impact on education. Get to know the individuals behind the project.

Justin Brundage

Founder, CEO, & President

I'm Justin Brundage, Founder and CEO of Homeroom Heroes. My journey began in August 2023, where I was inspired by a local radio station's effort to support teachers by fulfilling their classroom wish lists. Learning that teachers face the brunt of an $850 supplies bill, drove me to find a solution.

Growing up in a close-knit community, I experienced firsthand the profound impact teachers have on shaping lives. That's what pushed me to start Homeroom Heroes: a direct bridge between people who want to help and the teachers who need it. Unlike traditional donor sites, there is no middleman, no red tape, just classrooms getting what they need.

When I'm not working on changing education, you can usually find me out exploring the Pacific Northwest with my family and cheering on my alma mater Wazzu.

Join me in honoring the dedication of our teachers and making a lasting impact on education.

Sam Mahan

Co-Founder, CTO, & Treasurer

I'm Samuel Mahan, a software engineer dedicated to driving technological innovation and making a meaningful impact in the industry. With a background in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from Washington State University, I've honed my skills through various roles, including software development at Amazon and Adaptiva. My journey in the tech world began with a passion for problem-solving and a relentless drive to learn and adapt. Justin and I met during our freshman year at Washington State University, where our shared curiosity for technology sparked a lasting friendship and collaborative spirit. Today, I leverage my expertise to create robust backend services and firmware solutions, ensuring optimal performance and reliability. I'm committed to pushing boundaries and embracing new technologies to drive forward progress in the ever-evolving landscape of software engineering.

Tory Furr

COO & Secretary of the Board

Born and raised in the Pacific Northwest, I've seen firsthand the struggles many families face. Through my work as a property manager for income-restricted housing, I've witnessed the direct and profound impact that a good education has on a child's future. This experience ignited my passion for helping others, inspiring me to join Homeroom Heroes. My dedication to our community extends beyond my professional life, and in my free time, you can find me enjoying crafts, video games, hiking, and baking. I believe that by supporting our teachers, we're not just providing supplies; we're investing in the lives of our students and building a stronger, more resilient community for everyone.

Jillian Ortega

Board Member

I'm Jillian Ortega, I am an electrical engineer, a wife, and a mother of two children. As my children are nearing the age to enter the public school system the quality of education and the access to the tools they need to learn and thrive has become paramount. That is why I am honored to join this organization on the board of directors. I look forward to serving this community to the best of my abilities.

William Chappell

Board Member

I'm William Chappell, a Spokane Falls Community College alumnus and the oldest of four brothers. All three of my younger brothers are still in the public school system, which means education isn't just something I care about in the abstract. It's something I think about for the people closest to me every single day. Joining Homeroom Heroes felt like a natural extension of that. I want to make sure students in our community have access to the supplies they need to learn and grow, and I'm excited to help make that happen.

Majid Al-Hadrami

Board Member

I'm Majid Al-Hadrami, a 5th grade teacher, and it is my 4th year as a certificated public school employee. I have worked in several schools at both primary and secondary age levels across Washington state since 2018, primarily in Title 1 schools.

Coming from a family of educators, teaching is my passion. Supporting teachers, and by extension students, through this organization is a good way for me to get involved with the greater community.

Outside of school, you can find me swimming, lifting, at trivia or karaoke nights, or playing music and video games with friends and colleagues. I look forward to being involved with Homeroom Heroes!

© 2024 Homeroom Heroes. All rights reserved.
